project_name_raw: BUSH RIVER TIE 115/100 KV AUTOTRANSFORMERS, REPLACE
description_raw: Replace existing 115/100 kV autotransformers 7 and 8 with new transformers. Project is part of Red Zone 2.0.
supporting_statement_raw: Various generator interconnection studies have shown the need to upgrade this line. This upgrade is needed to enable generation consistent with the approved IRP.

project_name_raw: GTC: ADAMSVILLE - BUZZARD ROOST 230 KV REBUILD
description_raw: Rebuild about 5 miles of the Adamsville - Buzzard Roost 230 kV line with 200°C 1351 ACSS Martin.
supporting_statement_raw: The Adamsville - Buzzard Roost 230kV line overloads under contingency.

project_name_raw: GTC: EAST MOULTRIE - HIGHWAY 112 230 KV LINE
description_raw: Build approximately 27 miles of new 230 kV line between HWY 112 and East Moultrie substations with 160°C 1351 ACSS conductor.
supporting_statement_raw: This project addresses thermal overloads on the Daisy - West Valdosta 230 kV and Mitchell - Raccoon Creek 230 kV lines under contingency.

project_name_raw: GTC: REPLACE 230/115 KV AUTO TRANSFORMERS AT SOUTH HAZLEHURST
description_raw: Replace 230/115 kV auto transformers at South Hazlehurst with higher rating transformers.
supporting_statement_raw: The 230/115 kV auto transformers at South Hazlehurst overloads under contingency.

project_name_raw: SOCO: ANNISTON - BYNUM 115 KV TL UPGRADE
description_raw: Upgrade 6.5 miles from Coldwater – Anniston from 1351 ACSS 54/19 170°C to 200°C.
supporting_statement_raw: The Anniston - Bynum 115 kV transmission line overloads under contingency.

project_name_raw: SOCO: ATHENA - EAST WATKINSVILLE 115 KV REBUILD
description_raw: Rebuild approximately 8.47 miles of the Athena - East Watkinsville 115 kV line with 100°C ACSR 1033 conductor.
supporting_statement_raw: The Athena - East Watkinsville 115 kV line overloads under contingency.

project_name_raw: SOCO: AUTAUGAVILLE - EAST PELHAM NEW 230 KV TRANSMISSION LINE
description_raw: Construct ~75 miles new 230 kV transmission line bundled 795 ACSS at 200°C from Autaugaville TS to East Pelham TS.
supporting_statement_raw: The Bessemer – South Bessemer 230 kV transmission line overloads under contingency. Reduces multiple 230 kV line loadings and provides additional operational and maintenance flexibility, which increases reliability.

project_name_raw: SOCO: BESSEMER – SOUTH BESSEMER 115 KV TL RECONDUCTOR - PHASE 1
description_raw: Reconductor ~2 miles of 115 kV transmission line from South Bessemer TS to Bessemer TS from 397 ACSR at 100°C to 795 ACSS 26/7 at 200°C.
supporting_statement_raw: The Bessemer - South Bessemer 115 kV transmission line overloads under contingency.

project_name_raw: BULL RUN 500 KV SYNCHRONOUS CONDENSER, INSTALL
description_raw: Install breaker, switches, relaying, and metering to support synchronous condensing units at Bull Run 500 kV.
supporting_statement_raw: Voltage support and additional capacity is needed for economic development in the area.

project_name_raw: CORDOVA - YUM YUM 161 KV TRANSMISSION LINE, RECONDUCTOR
description_raw: Reconductor ~23.5 miles of the Cordova - Yum Yum 161 kV transmission line section with TS - 1098.6 kcmil Ruddy, sag temp 180°C.
supporting_statement_raw: Additional thermal capacity is needed for economic development in the Memphis, TN area.
